outcome: rate of successful vaginal delivery in induced labor
cohort: Pregnant women with DM1, live singleton fetus in cephalic presentation ≥34 gestational weeks delivering in Helsinki University Hospital between January 1st 2017 and December 31st 2019
finding: Planned vaginal delivery was associated with a lower rate of adverse perinatal outcome compared to planned Cesarean section, with no difference in the rates of adverse maternal outcome.
